steps.message: What events do I have in the next week in Simple Calendar Pro? Assume the week starts from Monday. Answer with the titles only. If there are multiples titles, format your answer in a comma separated list.
Execute: adb shell "date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z %z'; settings get system time_12_24; pm list packages | grep -iE 'simple|fossify|calendar'"

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell "date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z %z'; settings get system time_12_24; pm list packages | grep -iE 'simple|fossify|calendar'""

steps.message: Execute: adb shell 'now=$(date +%s); dow=$(date +%u); today=$((now - now%86400)); start=$((today + ((8-dow)%7)*86400)); end=$((start + 7*86400)); bms=$((start*1000)); ems=$((end*1000)); echo "RANGE $bms $ems"; content query --uri content://com.android.calendar/instances/when/$bms/$ems --projection title,begin,end,calendar_displayName --sort "begin ASC"'
